metadata.description: Curated collection of reusable patterns for bootstrapping projects with Claude Code

plugins.name: implement-lifecycle
plugins.description: Take a code change from request to merged with subagents, adversarial review from another model family, real verification and the ship command

plugins.name: bootstrap-worktrees
plugins.description: Set up project-agnostic worktree isolation with per-worktree ports, Docker Compose projects, and config files

plugins.name: issue-management
plugins.description: Draft, clean up, and refine GitHub issues — optimized for AI agent consumption

plugins.name: stop-guard
plugins.description: Stop hook that evaluates task completion via Gemini CLI and blocks premature stops

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Consult external AI CLIs (Codex, Antigravity) headlessly for a second-opinion code review of your changes
